purpose: Evaluate a validation-aware affine model after correcting query timing; same public verifier and archive format
previous_evidence: Version 3 data inspected and used to motivate this revision; 100000-record scale is previously exercised
sensitivity_mode: isolated fresh process per query with identical untimed primitive priming
order: Six-row Williams design repeated twice per development size and five times at evaluation; all six arm orders balanced; mode order alternates by sequence parity and six-block cycle, exactly 15 balanced-first and 15 isolated-first evaluation blocks.
timing: perf_counter_ns around one complete verify_proof call; returned-result checks and disposal after stop; proof construction, SHA256, IPC, process startup, crypto priming, file warming and explicit gc.collect excluded; normal verifier internal cleanup included
cache: Warm sequential read immediately before every timed call in both modes
model: Nonnegative affine full-query regression using intercept, validated record count, ECDSA token count, ML-DSA token count, SLH-DSA token count, enrollment objects and internal Merkle hashes
fit: Balanced development cell medians, inverse-median-latency weights, identical rows and objective for affine model and all five comparator/ablation models. Microbenchmark model separately calibrated as historical-form comparator.
secondary: Repeat point pass criterion in isolated mode; report conditional pointwise bootstrap intervals for each cell and paired bootstrap for median absolute relative error difference, corrected minus bytes-only.

bootstrap.unit: matched evaluation block with both modes, all arms and checkpoints kept together
bootstrap.scope: conditional on frozen development fit; no coefficient-refit uncertainty; fixed-grid comparison

exclusions: No statistical outlier removal; failures explicit; incomplete cells fail; any post-freeze correction requires disclosed versioning and new affected evaluation
freeze: Hash protocol, code, development measurements, calibration and fitted models; save separate hosted snapshot before evaluation. Private snapshot is not public preregistration or DOI. No independent human review implied.
retention: All raw times, counts, bytes, statuses, barrier traces and per-history selective proofs plus public enrollment policies retained; full archives/proofs discarded after verified counts/hashes because available disk is about 4 GiB.
mhealth: Historical secondary functional example only. No classifier performance or healthcare effectiveness inference in the primary study.
security_scope: Real native signatures; honest enrollment and modeled clock; no trusted timestamps, source/device attestation, formal cryptographic novelty or physical power-loss test
execution_isolation: synchronous local filesystem ZIP after each completed history

portable_execution_amendment.checkpoint: synchronous local filesystem ZIP after each completed history
portable_execution_amendment.scope: Same source algorithms and measurement boundaries; new keys, inputs, timings and model calibration. Local checkpoint is not an independent backup or trusted timestamp.
portable_execution_amendment.observation_persistence: Atomic checksummed journal of all 12 actual measurements per history, aggregate rebuilt from journals; workers stopped before commit
